name: luxafor-controller
title: Luxafor Controller
description: Control your Luxafor LED device directly from Raycast
author: smcnab1

commands.name: luxafor-status
commands.title: Luxafor Menu Bar
commands.description: View the last API-accepted command and send light changes; physical state is unknown

commands.name: set-busy
commands.title: Set Busy
commands.description: Send a solid red Luxafor command; suitable for an alias or hotkey

commands.name: set-available
commands.title: Set Available
commands.description: Send a solid green Luxafor command; suitable for an alias or hotkey

commands.name: turn-off
commands.title: Turn off
commands.description: Send custom 000000 to turn Luxafor off; suitable for an alias or hotkey

commands.name: custom-colour
commands.title: Set Custom Color
commands.description: Send a validated three- or six-digit hex color to Luxafor

preferences.name: userId
preferences.title: Luxafor User ID
preferences.description: Your Luxafor User ID from the Webhook tab in Luxafor software
preferences.label: User ID

preferences.name: apiEndpoint
preferences.title: API Endpoint
preferences.description: Use the documented .com service; .co.uk is retained for existing configurations and is unverified
preferences.label: API Endpoint

preferences.name: menubarMode
preferences.title: Menubar Layout
preferences.description: Choose Busy/Available actions or all seven base colors
preferences.label: Menubar Layout

preferences.name: debugMode
preferences.title: Legacy Debug Mode
preferences.description: Legacy setting retained; request bodies, responses and identifiers are never logged
preferences.label: Legacy Debug Mode

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
